name: Horilla
title: horilla.com
shortDescription: Horilla is an open-source HRMS solution designed to streamline HR operations for businesses of all sizes. It centralizes employee management, enhances payroll processing, and supports customizable HR workflows. Ideal for companies looking to manage HR tasks efficiently without cost, Horilla offers flexibility in hosting and extensive customization, making it suitable for diverse business needs.
pros: Customizable to fit various business needs
Supports self-hosting on local or live servers
cons: May require technical skill to deploy and customize
Limited support compared to paid products
Dependent on community for updates and features
